integrity: Exact stationary generator identities and numerical integral checks accompanied by independent analytic uniqueness and asymptotic proofs. Finite computations are not used as proofs of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Ideal complete resets to an already entangled GHZ state; local identical Markov depolarizing channels; no Hamiltonian, interactions, imperfect resets, non-Poisson intervals, or independent experimental validation. The two-term asymptotic is for n tending to infinity with fixed local decay rate.
title: A sharp linear reset-rate threshold for genuine GHZ entanglement under local depolarization
